title: Redis recovery and rebuild contract
rationale: Redis is operational coordination and short-lived ceremony state, not the durable authority for platform records.
PostgreSQL logical backups and protected platform asset snapshots are the durable recovery authorities.
Restoring an old redis_data volume after PostgreSQL/assets rollback can resurrect stale leases, challenges, throttles, or circuit state.

disaster_recovery_contract.post_restore_action: Start Redis empty for restored environments, or flush runtime namespaces before opening traffic.
rehydration_authorities: provider APIs only where a feature already has a reconciliation path
safe_to_rebuild_or_expire: rate limit and account security counters
project AI routing leases, concurrency windows, circuit state, and idempotency guards
must_not_become_authoritative: user, organization, project, consent, backup, restore, security scan, and remediation records

next_required_step: FR-04C4 should lock the DB/assets consistency boundary and retention/delete semantics before FR-04D.
